quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE teams with NVIDIA to advance secure agentic AI across (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPE introduced the NVIDIA Vera CPU Rack by HPE, a high-density, liquid-cooled system for CPU-intensive agentic AI and reinforcement learning workloads with 256 NVIDIA Vera CPUs, support for 22.5K sandboxes and 80% faster agentic CPU performance. HPE will support the NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture for Safe AI Agents (OpenShell on Vera, NVIDIA Sentry with BlueField-4, Vera Rubin NVL72 for inference) and NVIDIA DSX POD modular AI factories, building on its AI Mod POD. HPE Private Cloud AI can now combine NVIDIA H200 and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs in one cluster, with NVIDIA's KAI Scheduler (both generally available now); updates with the HPE AI Essentials API platform roll out in late 2026 and a self-service HPE AI Essentials developer experience (agent registration, API and MCP discovery) in 2027; HPE is expanding NVIDIA Confidential Computing on ProLiant Compute DL380a Gen12 servers with RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs. Schneider Electric plans to combine HPE Private Cloud AI, co-engineered with NVIDIA, with its industrial and operational technology expertise to support Industrial AI Agents at the Edge.
quarterly_data.figure: 256 NVIDIA Vera CPUs; 22.5K sandboxes; 80% faster agentic CPU performance
